# Seat 4 / B3 — preregistered 27-stick colour QR / light-bank memory and information-loss challenge

**2026-10-15. This protocol is committed BEFORE its new producer/verifier code, results or CI.** Parent [Seat4 Room04 draft PR #63](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/63) is independently reproducible software only, not a physical experiment. B3 is a **stacked draft** depending on that unmerged branch; this is not an authorization to merge PR #63.

## Exact dated source contracts

1. [The Colour QR](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/the-colour-qr/blob/1938a9b076b8fc3e81d0a271ca05e84a0e938854/README.md), original August 6 2026 method: split original payload bytes into **2,100-byte chunks**, prefix every chunk with a **uint32 little-endian chunk index**, Base64 encode the indexed chunk; assign chunk 3k, 3k+1, 3k+2 to R/G/B of **one colour-QR frame**. Filler is not data. Reconstruct regardless of retrieval order by index and verify SHA-256. We will execute the exact chunk, prefix, lane and Base64 **QR payload** contract. Ordinary image QR rasterization, screenshot decode or camera-based QR recovery are **NOT being claimed** by this B3 digital storage test: later experiments must explicitly implement independently decoded actual QR images.
2. [The Law of Space Light Colour](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/the-law-of-space-and-light-and-color-and-travel-at-the-speed-of-one/blob/1b2dd747bccee378b94790bc4ad367bdbf7e5bf8/README.md), August 1/7: exact rational projector `P = I - J/3`, kernel consisting of equal changes in R,G,B; the `-1/3` off-diagonal and `2/3` diagonal are a **mathematical** rule. A reversible projector *lift* must store a distinct ground/common-mode coordinate. We test the integer numerators `(3R - (R+G+B), 3G-(...),3B-(...))` and source anchor `R` (one 8-bit value per triple) so the original RGB bytes reconstruct. With no anchor, `(0,0,0)` and `(1,1,1)` collide; they cannot both be recovered. Do not infer FTL, photon-frame travel, or actual optical storage from this algebra.
3. [RAINBOR](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/RAINBOR/tree/56de9ee137f204452d7dff41f7b1e953b6ff5c3e) (August 8) documents a proposed three-wave/fourth-point optical bank and explicitly labels physical light-memory hardware **CONJECTURE**. [GitRAM](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/GitRAM/tree/e01425204b58dc680d1f3106410ff9ce71260b0d) supports reproducible stateless memory cells and artifact/manifest checkpointing. The **27 memory sticks below are simulated digital files**, not existing physical sticks and not 27 independent physical or even cloud hosts.
4. Phase A/B2 Seat 4 parent [PR #63](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/63) is pinned at B3 preregistration to head `8b8a9e4faa5b72fd1d5c290c686c1417a36d38ff`; source-complete offline capsule SHA256SUMS `67c2f6cc8e89dcec533c258bc159cdd1de27cd9bd510fbedab793a6892270cb6`. ## New B3 memory format and adversarial controls (not old QR claims)

- Build one typed **source archive** with explicit exact length, filename, offsets and SHA256 for each of the four B2 sources; no collision-prone delimiters. Prefix its canonical LF ASCII JSON manifest length as a four-byte little-endian integer, then append the raw source files in stated order. SHA256 of the full archive and total byte count are bound to the memory receipt.
- Chunk this typed archive at exactly **2,100 bytes**. Every chunk payload is **4-byte little-endian global index + body**, Base64 round-tripped and assigned to R/G/B by `i % 3`, into colour frame `i//3`. Final blank planes are filler, never 0-byte indexed chunks. Reverse shuffled frame retrieval using the indexed payload; assert exact final source archive and each component SHA.
- Store all frames across **27 simulated bank-stick files**, frame `f` on bank `f % 27`, stripe `f // 27`. Each bank record holds 4 fixed-size planes: 3 payload planes, each `2-byte length + up-to-2,104-byte indexed payload padded with zeros`, plus an explicitly **NEW fourth XOR parity plane R XOR G XOR B**. The 4th plane is **not** claimed to be part of the original August Colour QR standard and cannot be independently read by a conventional RGB QR decoder.
- Store an **additional dedicated parity-bank file** whose record is the XOR of all **27 data-bank records** at each stripe. This permits exact restoration after the erasure or checksum-detected corruption of **ONE entire data bank**. It is a new B3 software erasure code, not an existing optical medium.
- Test: exact whole-bank intact roundtrip; reversed/shuffled read order; every pixel channel Base64 indexed-payload roundtrip; independently recovered one R/G/B plane via fourth parity; detection and recovery of one erased full data bank; detection and recovery of one deliberately corrupted bank; **hold / fail closed when two entire banks erased** or two planes of the same frame erased (single XOR relation underdetermined); reject forged indices, duplicated chunk, injected payload mutation and stale manifest; maintain a separate immutable trusted manifest as the only accepted data-root reference. If both the manifest and all sources are compromised, classify `PROVENANCE_HOLD`, not authenticated memory.
- Use actual byte triples from the B2 `ticks.hbp` corpus to test the exact projector numerator `P=I-J/3` and a separately retained 8-bit common-mode/ground anchor: lossless with anchor, explicit non-injective collision without it. This is distinct from error-correcting parity.
- Re-run the existing independent 40-case GF(2) rank/nullspace suite and the original Room04 1,296 corruption/HALT controls, never conflate this with the different three-state/four-state photocycle experiments.
- Provide two **independent implementations**, Python bank producer and Node.js bank reader/verifier; Ubuntu+Windows and Python 3.11/3.13 CI. Generate full binary HBP bank cells, parity bank, complete source archive, canonical manifest, fault ledger and result JSON, write SHA256SUMS with LF, expose all as downloadable artifacts. Do not upload megabytes of binary HBP directly as source code to GitHub.
- Reject any unexpected MIME, shell execution, network calls from code, secret access, hidden files, extra fields interpreted as scope expansion, or physical optics/FTL claims. No automatic merge/Hugging Face upload. Actual external peer review by Seat 2 (#57) required.

## Falsification gates and scope

Count **bytes actually restored**, not only SHA comparisons. Record separately: real sample byte count, chunk count, frame count, per-bank data lengths, positive and negative gates, per-recovery status, full SHA, deterministic test seed. Fail if any accepted source differs by one byte; if a two-erasure case is declared uniquely reconstructed; if a corrupt source without verified parity is accepted; or if projector shadow alone is said to preserve its kernel. This test does **not** demonstrate physical optical memory, measured photon persistence, biological recall, faster-than-light propagation, entanglement, or independent physical-machine provenance. It measures software storage/recovery and data integrity under a modeled optical-addressing protocol only.
